name: deckR_lit_1
prompt: This is an upscaled crop of a photoreal audio-plugin UI. Output ONE image, landscape 1536x1024, with EXACTLY the same framing, scale, perspective, lighting, colours and every detail as the input, so it overlays the input pixel for pixel. Change ONLY this: switch pedals A, B and C ON: each round lamp glows warm amber, and each pedal block is pressed down (shorter, tilted look) with a warm amber glow showing under its top edge, exactly like a lit, pressed pedal. The black panel texture, labels, boxes, slider and everything else stay exactly the same. Everything outside that change must stay identical to the input.

name: ends_walnut_1
